user_clarification: 六个跨域实验设置，三个候选创新点；学习经典算法的思想为论文提供理论支撑，不是用经典算法校准判断。
terminology: three candidate innovations in one unified framework, evaluated in six cross-domain experimental settings

candidate_innovations.name: 面向覆盖和可辨识性的主动观察
candidate_innovations.human_inspiration: 先形成场景覆盖，再集中细看疑点
candidate_innovations.task_design: Pay for object anchors, then choose new objects or state contrasts using a common conditional coverage/excitation objective. The current geometry-only prototype does not yet use teacher-dependent doubt or structural residuals.
candidate_innovations.conditional_theory: The implemented frozen-anchor, equal-unit-cost second-stage proxy is monotone submodular. Its greedy bound concerns incremental proxy gain, not global two-stage optimality, true Fisher information, HOTA or wall-clock utility.
candidate_innovations.empirical_gate: Same-budget DESIGN/COVERAGE_ONLY/PRIOR/UNIFORM evidence collection, ordinary distillation sharing each policy's exact answers, then complete six-setting quality and real cost. Manifests and physical input pilots are not this gate.

candidate_innovations.name: 分离稳定干扰与关系变化的对比证据学习
candidate_innovations.human_inspiration: 同一对象前后对比时，区分对象本身、观察通道与发生变化的关系；重复答案不自动成为独立证据
classical_principles: 组内对比、消去干扰与可辨识性
相关证据的信息量约束
candidate_innovations.task_design: Within query/provided-TrackID/view/video centering, exact input/answer deduplication, unit group mass and a nonnegative robust scalar state-response fit. This is the current narrow prototype, not a completed general evidence learner.
candidate_innovations.conditional_theory: Fixed-weight centering cancels additive stable intercepts. No within-group state variation means no slope identification; ridge uniqueness does not fix it. Strong convexity and bounded group influence concern the scalar fit. Confidence-dependent weights, clipping and state-dependent teacher errors limit the claim.
candidate_innovations.empirical_gate: Teacher-only heldout response prediction is intermediate evidence. Compare centered/uncentered fits and matched ordinary per-frame distillation after all raw/count outputs seal; no target GT selects parameters.
candidate_innovations.ongoing_refinement: Learn reference pseudo-targets after removing the teacher state component, rather than treating a composite unary as a reference. Current fixed-evidence trial and matched ordinary direct/residual frame baselines are registered separately; no acceptance claim.

candidate_innovations.name: 对象—状态分解下的关系化指代
candidate_innovations.human_inspiration: 保持对象理解，更新其当前关系，并用语言描述间的兼容性检查局部判断
classical_principles: 稳定成分与动态状态分解、关系迁移
candidate_innovations.task_design: Use learned within-object state response to produce observation-specific referring scores, with exact fallback for unsupported language. Existing query-implication constraints remain separate evidence; joint per-frame consistency after transport has not yet been implemented.
candidate_innovations.conditional_theory: A correct additive state model, correct reference unary/slope and no active cap give conditional reconstruction. The odds cap bounds the change, not its correctness. Convex projection properties require correct relations and the projection actually being applied to the stated variable.
candidate_innovations.empirical_gate: Dynamic versus time-average, value-preserving shuffle, reference and both CountMatched controls; same geometry/answers for adequate ordinary frame distillation. A left/right-only gate is not evidence of universal module coverage.
candidate_innovations.ongoing_refinement: scripts/a100_object_reference.py trains a reference representation before state reconstruction; same-fallback ordinary hybrid, unshifted targets, time mean, reference-center, shuffled state and both count directions test the claimed contribution.

evaluation: Same method and parameter rules across settings; shared-budget ordinary distillation, three leave-one-module-out ablations and necessary interaction/quantity controls. A module need not improve every setting separately.

derivation_order: Task failure and necessary information -> explicit structural assumptions -> task-specific mechanism -> conditional mathematical property -> fair empirical test. Classic algorithm names and copied theorems are not the contributions.
three_point_chain: What to observe -> what changes can be identified -> how to infer the current referring relation
not_yet_completed: The three pieces are candidate mechanisms, not a validated unified framework. The active goal still requires reliable improvement over fair ordinary teacher distillation across all six settings, component/interaction attribution and actual deployment cost.
